entry.title: BIP 110: update status to closed
entry.summary: The discussion revolves around the implementation and timing protocols associated with Bitcoin Improvement Proposals (BIPs). Specifically, it addresses BIP 3's requirement for a four-week period before any BIP can be moved to a "closed" status. This timing is critical because if fewer than one block per four-week period is discovered, it suggests that reaching the difficulty retarget point could potentially take up to 150 years. Therefore, the recommendation is made not to mark the BIP as closed until there has been a significant lapse of time—specifically 18-28 days since the detection of the last BIP110 compliant block. This approach ensures adherence to the protocol and acknowledges the long durations that might be involved in the process due to the slow rate of block findings. Such careful consideration is crucial for maintaining the integrity and accuracy of the blockchain development process.
